parts.t: Campbell Valley acreages and farms represent exceptional rural opportunities in Langley Township with
, agricultural land, and country estates. This scenic area attracts buyers seeking substantial parcels for horses, hobby farming, or the privacy and space that

provide in a coveted location. Properties feature diverse options from smaller acreages to impressive equestrian estates with barns, arenas, pastures, and all infrastructure serious riders require, plus working farms and agricultural operations.

Residents appreciate the stunning mountain views, proximity to Campbell Valley Regional Park with extensive riding and hiking trails, plus the strong equestrian community including facilities and trainers. Despite the rural character, Langley and South Surrey shopping, excellent schools, and services remain accessible via good road access. The area's natural beauty, established equestrian infrastructure, and limited inventory support strong property values. Whether you're seeking horses, hobby farming, or country investment, Campbell Valley delivers premium rural living. Contact me for available acreages and recent rural sales in this prestigious area.
